Hero.subtitle: Bespoke Menswear
Hero.description:
Premium bespoke tailoring for the modern Indian gentleman.
Suits, sherwanis, and luxury fabric gifting —
crafted with precision, fitted to perfection.

formalSuit.title: Two-Piece Formal Suit
formalSuit.desc: Impeccably tailored from premium wool and linen. Slim, regular, or relaxed fit — measured to your exact silhouette.

sherwani.title: Royal Groom Sherwani
sherwani.desc: Exquisite hand-embroidered wedding sherwanis in silk, velvet, and brocade. The centrepiece of your celebration.

tuxedo.title: Premium Tuxedo
tuxedo.desc: Black-tie perfection with satin peak lapels and hand-finished details. For galas, receptions, and landmark evenings.

pathani.title: Classic Pathani
pathani.desc: Timeless Pathani suits in cotton and linen blends. Effortless elegance for festivals, prayers, and everyday refinement.

safari.title: Executive Safari Suit
safari.desc: The power suit of Indian professionals. Structured shoulders, smart pockets, and a commanding presence in the boardroom.

gifting.title: Luxury Fabric Gifting
gifting.desc: Curated gift boxes of premium fabrics, silk ties, and accessories. The perfect corporate or festive gift.

Craftsmanship.paragraph1: Since 1998, Fashion Look has been the destination for gentlemen who understand that a suit is more than just clothing — it is a statement of intent.
Craftsmanship.paragraph2: Every garment that leaves our atelier is the result of hours of meticulous hand-stitching, canvassing, and finishing. We source our fabrics from the finest mills across the globe, ensuring that your bespoke piece not only looks extraordinary but stands the test of time.

Footer.subtitle: Cloth & Stitching
Footer.description: Premium bespoke tailoring and luxury fabric gifting, crafted with precision in Navi Mumbai.

Process.title: Our Bespoke Process
Process.step1Desc: We begin with a conversation about your lifestyle, preferred silhouettes, and occasions. Explore our curated selection of premium fabrics from global mills.
Process.step2Desc: A master tailor takes exacting measurements, ensuring every contour is accounted for to create a garment that drapes flawlessly.
Process.step3Desc: The first trial. Your garment is temporarily stitched together to perfect the fit, balance, and proportions before final construction.
Process.step4Desc: Your finished garment is ready. We ensure all final details are pristine, delivering a piece of wearable art crafted specifically for you.
